blocks.en: Introduction, Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解 PDA PtC No. 12 的定位：這是一份專門針對 RABS 的業界最佳實踐指引，而非法規標準
blocks.en: Understand the positioning of PDA PtC No. 12: it is an industry best-practice guide dedicated to RABS, not a regulation or standard

blocks.zh: 掌握 RABS 與 Isolator 的根本性差異，以及為何需要獨立的指引文件
blocks.en: Grasp the fundamental differences between RABS and isolators, and why a separate guidance document is needed

blocks.zh: 熟悉 RABS 技術中常用的關鍵術語定義，特別是 oRABS / cRABS 的區別
blocks.en: Become familiar with the key terms commonly used in RABS technology, especially the distinction between oRABS and cRABS

blocks.zh: 了解本文件的範圍涵蓋 RABS 全生命週期：設計、確效、操作與屏障系統介面
blocks.en: Understand that the scope of this document covers the whole RABS lifecycle: design, qualification, operation and barrier system interfaces

blocks.zh: Introduction 簡介
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Restricted Access Barrier Systems, RABS (限制進出屏障系統)：RABS 是一種用於無菌製程的物理屏障技術。它提供一個封閉但並非完全密封的環境，透過剛性壁面、整合式手套、單向氣流等設計，將操作人員與 Grade A 關鍵區域隔離，從而降低微生物和微粒污染的風險。
blocks.en: Restricted Access Barrier Systems (RABS): RABS is a physical barrier technology used in aseptic processing. It provides an enclosed but not fully sealed environment and uses rigid walls, integrated gloves and unidirectional airflow to separate operators from the Grade A critical zone, thereby reducing the risk of microbial and particulate contamination.

blocks.zh: PDA (Parenteral Drug Association)：全球最大的注射劑藥品技術協會，其發布的 Points to Consider 系列文件代表業界專家的共識觀點，雖非法規要求，但在實務中被廣泛採用為最佳實踐依據。
blocks.en: PDA (Parenteral Drug Association): The world's largest technical association for injectable drug products. Its Points to Consider series reflects the consensus view of industry experts; although it is not a regulatory requirement, it is widely adopted in practice as a basis for best practice.

blocks.zh: 本文件定位：這是 PDA 首份專門針對 RABS 的完整指引。在此之前，RABS 的相關知識散見於各法規和技術報告中，缺乏系統性的整合。
blocks.en: Positioning of this document: This is the first complete PDA guidance dedicated to RABS. Before it, RABS knowledge was scattered across various regulations and technical reports, with no systematic consolidation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在一間高級餐廳的開放式廚房工作。Isolator (隔離器) 就像是把整個料理區用密封玻璃罩完全隔離，廚師只能透過手套操作；而 RABS 則像是在料理區與用餐區之間設置了透明屏障，廚師主要透過整合的手套操作，但在嚴格控制的條件下可以短暫開門進行特定操作。兩者都比沒有屏障的傳統開放廚房安全得多，但設計邏輯和操作規範截然不同。
blocks.en: Imagine working in the open kitchen of a high-end restaurant. An isolator is like sealing the entire cooking area under a closed glass enclosure, with the chefs working only through gloves. A RABS is more like placing a transparent barrier between the cooking area and the dining area: the chefs work mainly through the integrated gloves, but under strictly controlled conditions they can briefly open a door for specific tasks. Both are much safer than a traditional open kitchen with no barrier, but the design logic and operating rules are very different.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: RABS =/= Isolator：文件特別強調 RABS 與 Isolator 是「非常不同的技術」(a very different technology)。主要差異包括：
blocks.en: RABS =/= Isolator: The document stresses that RABS and isolators are "a very different technology". The main differences include:

blocks.zh: 背景環境要求：RABS 需要 Grade B 背景環境，Isolator 可在 Grade D
blocks.en: Background environment: RABS requires a Grade B background; an isolator can sit in a Grade D background

blocks.zh: 去污方法：RABS 以手動擦拭消毒為主，Isolator 使用自動化 VPHP 去污
blocks.en: Decontamination method: RABS relies mainly on manual wipe disinfection; isolators use automated VPHP decontamination

blocks.zh: 密封程度：RABS 不完全密封（有 mouseholes 等開口），Isolator 追求完全隔離
blocks.en: Degree of sealing: RABS is not fully sealed (it has openings such as mouseholes); isolators aim for complete separation

blocks.zh: 開門操作：RABS 在嚴格條件下允許開門介入，Isolator 原則上不開門
blocks.en: Door opening: RABS allows door-open interventions under strict conditions; isolators in principle are not opened

blocks.zh: 這些差異直接影響設施設計、確效策略和日常操作程序。
blocks.en: These differences directly affect facility design, qualification strategy and day-to-day operating procedures.

blocks.zh: 法規背景 Regulatory Context
blocks.en: Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: 本文件頻繁引用的法規基礎：
blocks.en: Regulatory bases frequently cited in this document:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)：歐盟最新的無菌製造規範，對 RABS 和 Isolator 提出了明確但有區別的要求。PIC/S GMP Annex 1 與之完全相同。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): The latest EU GMP requirements for sterile manufacturing, setting out clear but distinct requirements for RABS and isolators. PIC/S GMP Annex 1 is identical.

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance (2004)：美國 FDA 的無菌製程指引，雖然年代較早，但其核心原則仍然適用。
blocks.en: FDA Guidance (2004): The US FDA guidance on aseptic processing. Although older, its core principles still apply.

blocks.zh: PDA PtC No. 1 (2023)：PDA 無菌製程的總體指引，許多原則同樣適用於 RABS。
blocks.en: PDA PtC No. 1 (2023): PDA's general guidance on aseptic processing; many of its principles apply equally to RABS.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PDA 認為有必要為 RABS 單獨編寫一份 Points to Consider？既有的 Isolator 指引為何不足以涵蓋 RABS？
blocks.en: Why did PDA consider it necessary to write a separate Points to Consider for RABS? Why are existing isolator guidance documents not sufficient to cover RABS?

blocks.zh: 本文件明確聲明「不代表標準或法規指引」，那麼在法規查核（regulatory inspection）時，這份文件扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: The document explicitly states that it "does not represent a standard or regulatory guidance". What role does it play during a regulatory inspection?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠正在評估從傳統開放式充填線升級到 RABS，你會優先關注本文件中的哪些面向？
blocks.en: If your site is evaluating an upgrade from a conventional open filling line to RABS, which aspects of this document would you focus on first?

blocks.zh: Scope 範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 範圍解析 Scope Analysis
blocks.en: Scope Analysis

blocks.zh: 本文件的範圍涵蓋 RABS 的全生命週期：
blocks.en: The scope of this document covers the whole lifecycle of RABS:

blocks.zh: 設計與應用 (Design & Application)：如何選擇和配置 RABS
blocks.en: Design & Application: how to select and configure a RABS

blocks.zh: 確效 (Qualification)：如何驗證 RABS 系統符合預期功能
blocks.en: Qualification: how to demonstrate that the RABS performs as intended

blocks.zh: 操作 (Operation)：日常使用中的最佳實踐
blocks.en: Operation: best practices for routine use

blocks.zh: 屏障系統介面 (Barrier System Interfaces)：RABS 與其他設備的銜接處理
blocks.en: Barrier System Interfaces: how the RABS is linked to other equipment

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，雖然主要針對無菌製程 (Aseptic Processing)，但原則也適用於終端滅菌和低生物負荷製程中使用的 RABS。
blocks.en: Note that although the document focuses on aseptic processing, its principles also apply to RABS used in terminal sterilization and low-bioburden processes.

blocks.zh: 這份文件就像是一本駕駛手冊：它涵蓋了從買車（設計選擇）、領牌驗車（確效）、日常駕駛（操作）到停車入庫（介面管理）的完整內容。雖然主要是為高速公路駕駛（無菌製程）而寫，但許多規則在一般道路（終端滅菌製程）上也同樣適用。
blocks.en: This document is like a driver's manual: it covers everything from buying the car (design choices), registering and inspecting it (qualification), and daily driving (operation) to parking it in the garage (interface management). Although it is written mainly for highway driving (aseptic processing), many of its rules also apply on ordinary roads (terminal sterilization processes).

blocks.zh: Glossary 術語表
blocks.en: Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 - 清潔與去污層級
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Cleaning and Decontamination Levels

blocks.zh: 本術語表中有一組容易混淆的概念，需要特別釐清其層級關係：
blocks.en: This glossary contains a set of easily confused terms whose hierarchy needs to be clarified:

blocks.zh: Cleaning (清潔)：去除可見污垢與殘留物
blocks.en: Cleaning: removal of visible soil and residues

blocks.zh: Disinfection (消毒)：降低微生物數量至適當水平，但不一定能殺滅芽孢
blocks.en: Disinfection: reduction of the number of microorganisms to an appropriate level, but not necessarily the destruction of spores

blocks.zh: Bio-decontamination (生物去污)：使用殺孢子劑消除生物負荷
blocks.en: Bio-decontamination: elimination of bioburden using a sporicidal agent

blocks.zh: Sterilization (滅菌)：消除所有存活微生物（最高等級）
blocks.en: Sterilization: elimination of all viable microorganisms (the highest level)

blocks.zh: Decontamination (去污)：涵蓋上述所有方法的總稱
blocks.en: Decontamination: a general term covering all of the above methods

blocks.zh: 在 RABS 的操作情境中，通常使用 Disinfection 和 Bio-decontamination 而非 Sterilization，因為 RABS 內部表面通常是手動擦拭消毒，而非透過自動化系統進行滅菌。
blocks.en: In RABS operations, disinfection and bio-decontamination are normally used rather than sterilization, because the internal surfaces of a RABS are usually disinfected by manual wiping rather than sterilized by an automated system.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 - Intervention 介入操作分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Classification of Interventions

blocks.zh: Intervention (介入操作) 的分類是 RABS 操作管理中最關鍵的概念之一：
blocks.en: The classification of interventions is one of the most important concepts in RABS operational management:

blocks.zh: Inherent Intervention (固有介入)：製程中必須執行的操作，例如環境監測取樣、容器補充。這些是可預期、有計畫的。
blocks.en: Inherent Intervention: an operation that must be performed as part of the process, such as environmental monitoring sampling or container replenishment. These are foreseeable and planned.

blocks.zh: Corrective Intervention (矯正介入)：因異常而執行的操作，例如清除卡瓶、修復洩漏。這些是不可預期的。
blocks.en: Corrective Intervention: an operation performed because of an abnormality, such as clearing a stoppered or jammed vial or repairing a leak. These are unplanned.

blocks.zh: Critical Intervention (關鍵介入)：任何進入 Critical Zone 的介入，無論是固有或矯正。在 RABS 環境中，這特別指需要開門的操作。
blocks.en: Critical Intervention: any intervention that enters the critical zone, whether inherent or corrective. In a RABS environment this refers specifically to operations that require opening a door.

blocks.zh: RABS 的操作程序設計應盡量減少所有介入操作，尤其是需要開門的 Critical Intervention。
blocks.en: RABS operating procedures should be designed to minimize all interventions, especially critical interventions that require opening a door.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 - First Air 初始空氣
blocks.en: Analogy - First Air

blocks.zh: First Air (初始空氣) 的概念可以用淋浴來理解：想像你站在蓮蓬頭下方，水從上方直接流到你身上，這就是「初始水流」；但如果水先碰到牆壁再彈到你身上，那就不再是初始水流了，因為它可能已經攜帶了牆上的髒污。
blocks.en: The concept of First Air can be understood through a shower: when you stand under the showerhead, water flows directly from above onto you, which is the "first water". If the water hits the wall first and then bounces onto you, it is no longer first water, because it may already have picked up dirt from the wall.

blocks.zh: 同理，從 HEPA 過濾器出來的空氣直接吹到產品暴露表面，中間沒有被任何障礙物阻擋或擾亂，這就是 First Air。任何阻礙初始空氣的物體都可能在空氣抵達 Critical Zone 之前引入污染。
blocks.en: Likewise, air leaving the HEPA filter and blowing directly onto the exposed product surfaces, with no obstacle blocking or disturbing it in between, is First Air. Any object that obstructs first air may introduce contamination before the air reaches the critical zone.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - Hold Time 管理
blocks.en: Key Notes - Hold Time Management

blocks.zh: Hold Time（維持時間）在 RABS 操作中扮演關鍵角色。三種 Hold Time 構成了時間控管的完整鏈條：
blocks.en: Hold time plays a key role in RABS operations. Three types of hold time form a complete chain of time control:

blocks.zh: Clean Hold Time：清潔完成 → 滅菌/去污開始（確保清潔狀態不劣化）
blocks.en: Clean Hold Time: completion of cleaning to start of sterilization/decontamination (ensures the cleaned state does not deteriorate)

blocks.zh: Sterile Hold Time：滅菌完成 → 實際使用（確保無菌狀態維持）
blocks.en: Sterile Hold Time: completion of sterilization to actual use (ensures the sterile state is maintained)

blocks.zh: Aseptic Hold Time：無菌操作準備完成 → 製程結束（確保無菌製程持續可靠）
blocks.en: Aseptic Hold Time: completion of aseptic set-up to end of the process (ensures the aseptic process remains reliable)

blocks.zh: 每種 Hold Time 都需要經過驗證 (validation)，超時則需要重新處理。在 RABS 環境中，由於不完全密封的特性，這些時間限制通常比 Isolator 更為嚴格。
blocks.en: Each hold time must be validated, and exceeding it requires reprocessing. In a RABS environment, because of its not fully sealed nature, these time limits are usually stricter than for an isolator.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - Grade A vs ISO 5
blocks.en: Key Notes - Grade A vs ISO 5

blocks.zh: 文件特別註明 Grade A 與 ISO 5 在本文中可互換使用。但要注意，Grade A 是 EU GMP 的分類（涵蓋微粒和微生物限度），而 ISO 5 是 ISO 14644 的分類（僅涵蓋微粒）。Grade A 在概念上更為嚴格，因為它同時包含微生物監測要求。
blocks.en: The document notes that Grade A and ISO 5 are used interchangeably in the text. Be aware, however, that Grade A is an EU GMP classification (covering both particulate and microbial limits), whereas ISO 5 is a classification under ISO 14644 (particulates only). Grade A is conceptually more stringent because it also includes microbial monitoring requirements.

blocks.zh: Grade A Air Supply 是一個特殊概念：空氣品質達到 Grade A 微粒標準，但不需要連續微粒監測或符合 Grade A 微生物限度。主要用於完全加塞但尚未鋁蓋封口的小瓶保護。
blocks.en: Grade A Air Supply is a special concept: air quality that meets the Grade A particulate standard but does not require continuous particle monitoring or compliance with the Grade A microbial limits. It is mainly used to protect fully stoppered vials that have not yet been crimped.

blocks.zh: 在 oRABS 環境中執行 Bio-decontamination 時，為什麼是手動擦拭而非自動化去污？這對操作人員的訓練有什麼影響？
blocks.en: When bio-decontamination is performed in an oRABS, why is it done by manual wiping rather than automated decontamination? What does this mean for operator training?

blocks.zh: 試舉出三個在 RABS 充填線上可能發生的 Corrective Intervention 範例，並說明它們為何構成 Critical Intervention。
blocks.en: Give three examples of corrective interventions that could occur on a RABS filling line, and explain why they constitute critical interventions.

blocks.zh: 如果 Sterile Hold Time 驗證為 24 小時，但某批次的滅菌零件因排程延遲在 26 小時後才使用，應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If the sterile hold time has been validated for 24 hours, but sterilized parts for a batch are not used until 26 hours later because of a scheduling delay, how should this be handled?

blocks.zh: Glossary (continued) 術語表（續）
blocks.en: Glossary (continued)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 - cRABS vs oRABS
blocks.en: Analogy - cRABS vs oRABS

blocks.zh: 想像兩種不同的手術環境：
blocks.en: Imagine two different surgical environments:

blocks.zh: cRABS 就像一間有獨立空調系統的手術室，門通常關著，空氣不會與走廊混合，但門底下仍有小縫隙（mouseholes），需要時可以開門。
blocks.en: A cRABS is like an operating room with its own dedicated air conditioning system. The doors are normally closed and the air does not mix with the corridor, but there are still small gaps under the doors (mouseholes), and the door can be opened when needed.

blocks.zh: oRABS 就像一間使用走廊空調的手術室，雖然有門和屏障，但空氣會與走廊交換。因此，走廊（Grade B 背景環境）的空氣品質對手術室內的潔淨度至關重要。
blocks.en: An oRABS is like an operating room that uses the corridor's air conditioning. Although it has doors and a barrier, the air is exchanged with the corridor. The air quality of the corridor (the Grade B background) is therefore critical to the cleanliness inside the operating room.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - 6-Log Reduction
blocks.en: Key Notes - 6-Log Reduction

blocks.zh: 6-Log Reduction (六對數減少) 是去污效力的重要指標。「6-log」表示微生物數量減少到原來的百萬分之一 (10-6)。
blocks.en: 6-Log Reduction is an important measure of decontamination efficacy. "6-log" means the microbial count is reduced to one-millionth of the original (10-6).

blocks.zh: 在 RABS 環境中，6-log reduction 通常是 bio-decontamination 製程的驗收標準。使用 Biological Indicator (BI) 來驗證去污製程是否達到此標準。
blocks.en: In a RABS environment, a 6-log reduction is usually the acceptance criterion for the bio-decontamination process. Biological indicators (BIs) are used to verify that the decontamination process achieves this level.

blocks.zh: 對照：Isolator 的 VPHP 去污通常也要求至少 6-log reduction。
blocks.en: By comparison, VPHP decontamination of isolators also usually requires at least a 6-log reduction.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - RTP 快速傳遞口
blocks.en: Key Notes - RTP (Rapid Transfer Port)

blocks.zh: Rapid Transfer Port, RTP (快速傳遞口) 是 RABS 和 Isolator 中用於物料傳入的關鍵裝置。其 alpha/beta port 設計原理：
blocks.en: The Rapid Transfer Port (RTP) is a key device for transferring materials into RABS and isolators. The alpha/beta port design principle is as follows:

blocks.zh: Alpha port：安裝在 RABS/Isolator 壁面上的固定部分
blocks.en: Alpha port: the fixed part mounted on the RABS/isolator wall

blocks.zh: Beta port：安裝在傳遞容器上的配對部分
blocks.en: Beta port: the matching part mounted on the transfer container

blocks.zh: 對接時，兩個 port 的外露面（可能受污染的面）被夾在中間，不會接觸到 RABS 內部
blocks.en: When docked, the outer faces of the two ports (the faces that may be contaminated) are sandwiched between them and never come into contact with the inside of the RABS

blocks.zh: 在 RABS 中使用 RTP 可以減少開門操作的需求，是降低污染風險的重要設計。
blocks.en: Using an RTP in a RABS reduces the need to open doors and is an important design feature for lowering contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 - VPHP 與 RABS 的關係
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Relationship between VPHP and RABS

blocks.zh: 注意 VPHP (汽化過氧化氫) 的定義中明確提到是用於「isolator 內部的去污」。這反映了一個重要事實：VPHP 自動去污是 Isolator 的標準配備，但不是 RABS 的標準配備。
blocks.en: Note that the definition of VPHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) explicitly refers to "decontamination of the inside of an isolator". This reflects an important fact: automated VPHP decontamination is standard equipment for isolators but not for RABS.

blocks.zh: RABS（特別是 oRABS）通常依靠手動擦拭殺孢子劑來達成 bio-decontamination。cRABS 雖然結構上更接近 Isolator，但也「通常沒有自動化 biodecontamination 系統」。
blocks.en: RABS (especially oRABS) normally rely on manual wiping with sporicidal agents to achieve bio-decontamination. Although a cRABS is structurally closer to an isolator, it also "normally has no automated bio-decontamination system".

blocks.zh: 這個差異對操作程序、人員訓練和確效策略有深遠影響。
blocks.en: This difference has far-reaching implications for operating procedures, personnel training and qualification strategy.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：假設你的 CDMO 工廠目前使用 oRABS 進行無菌充填，一家客戶要求升級到 cRABS。從本術語表的定義出發，你需要考慮的主要變更包括：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose your CDMO site currently uses an oRABS for aseptic filling and a client asks for an upgrade to a cRABS. Based on the definitions in this glossary, the main changes you need to consider include:

blocks.zh: 空氣供應系統從共用 HVAC 改為專用 UDAF
blocks.en: Changing the air supply from a shared HVAC system to a dedicated UDAF

blocks.zh: 屏障設計需要阻止空氣交換（但仍需保留 mouseholes 供容器進出）
blocks.en: Designing the barrier to prevent air exchange (while still keeping mouseholes for container entry and exit)

blocks.zh: 去污程序可能需要重新設計和驗證
blocks.en: The decontamination procedure may need to be redesigned and validated

blocks.zh: Hold Time 參數可能需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Hold time parameters may need to be revalidated

blocks.zh: 介入操作（Intervention）的程序和評估標準需要更新
blocks.en: The procedures and evaluation criteria for interventions need to be updated

blocks.zh: Document Structure Overview 文件結構概述
blocks.en: Document Structure Overview

blocks.zh: 文件結構解析
blocks.en: Document Structure Analysis

blocks.zh: 本 PtC 採用的 Q&A 結構非常有特色，每個議題包含四個層次：
blocks.en: The Q&A structure used in this PtC is distinctive. Each topic contains four layers:

blocks.zh: Problem Statement (問題陳述)：以提問形式呈現業界實際面臨的疑問
blocks.en: Problem Statement: presented as a question reflecting real queries faced by the industry

blocks.zh: Recommendation (建議)：由專家小組提出的最佳實踐建議
blocks.en: Recommendation: best-practice recommendations put forward by the expert team

blocks.zh: Rationale (理據)：解釋為什麼如此建議
blocks.en: Rationale: an explanation of why the recommendation is made

blocks.zh: References (參考文獻)：支持建議的文獻依據
blocks.en: References: the literature supporting the recommendation

blocks.zh: 這種結構使得讀者可以直接找到與自身問題相關的議題，而不必通讀全文。在後續章節的學習中，請注意識別這四個層次。
blocks.en: This structure allows readers to go straight to the topic relevant to their own question without reading the whole document. As you study the following sections, note how to identify these four layers.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 文件定位：PDA PtC No. 12 是首份專門針對 RABS 的業界指引，代表專家共識而非法規要求，但在實務中具有重要參考價值
blocks.en: Positioning of the document: PDA PtC No. 12 is the first industry guidance dedicated to RABS; it represents expert consensus rather than a regulatory requirement, but is an important reference in practice

blocks.zh: RABS vs Isolator：兩者是根本不同的技術，在密封程度、去污方式、背景環境要求和開門操作規範上有本質差異
blocks.en: RABS vs isolator: The two are fundamentally different technologies, differing in essence in degree of sealing, decontamination method, background environment requirements and rules for door opening

blocks.zh: RABS 兩大類型：cRABS（封閉式）阻止空氣交換並使用專用 UDAF；oRABS（開放式）允許空氣交換，對背景環境要求更高
blocks.en: Two main RABS types: a cRABS (closed) prevents air exchange and uses a dedicated UDAF; an oRABS (open) allows air exchange and places higher demands on the background environment

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：掌握 Critical Zone、First Air、Intervention 分類、Hold Time 類型、Bio-decontamination 等核心概念，是理解後續章節的基礎
blocks.en: Key terms: Mastering core concepts such as critical zone, first air, classification of interventions, types of hold time and bio-decontamination is the foundation for understanding the following sections

blocks.zh: 全生命週期範圍：本文件涵蓋 RABS 的設計、確效、操作和介面管理，適用於無菌製程及終端滅菌/低生物負荷製程
blocks.en: Whole-lifecycle scope: The document covers RABS design, qualification, operation and interface management, and applies to aseptic processing as well as terminal sterilization and low-bioburden processes

blocks.zh: Q&A 結構：後續章節採用 Problem Statement → Recommendation → Rationale → References 的四層結構
blocks.en: Q&A structure: The following sections use a four-layer structure of Problem Statement → Recommendation → Rationale → References
